task.title: Choose a Firefox schema channel
task.shortdesc: Choose between Firefox ESR 140.12 and Firefox Release 152 before importing, validating, or editing a profile.

prereq.p: Start this task before creating a profile, importing policies.json, or validating a raw JSON document.

context.p: The schema channel decides which Firefox policies BPM can validate and which controls are shown as supported. ESR 140.12 is the default long-support channel; Release 152 is the current mainstream channel and includes newer policy controls such as AIControls and VisualSearchEnabled.

step.cmd: Compare the target browser fleet with the supported channels: ESR 140.12 or Release 152.

info.p: Expected result: the selected schema channel remains visible and intentional.

step.cmd: Choose ESR 140.12 when the profile is intended for the supported Extended Support Release deployment.

info.p: Expected result: the selected schema channel remains visible and intentional.

step.cmd: Choose Release 152 when the profile needs current Release-only controls, including supported AI and visual search policies.

info.p: Expected result: the selected schema channel remains visible and intentional.

step.cmd: Validate after choosing the channel and before saving, export, or handoff.

info.note: Validation can change from valid to invalid when the schema channel changes. Confirm the channel before saving or exporting.

result.p: The profile uses the schema channel that matches the intended Firefox deployment.

postreq.p: Recovery: if validation reports unsupported, unavailable, deprecated, or unknown settings, confirm the schema channel before editing policy values.
